rule: an ordinary test must not write a protected path

entries.authority: the committed bytes are the R1 record
entries.trigger: npx vitest run tests/r1-report.spec.ts (also inside the full suite)
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten unconditionally at the end of the test

entries.authority: the committed manifest describes the committed docs
entries.defaultBehavior: regenerated from the docs directory at the end of the test

entries.authority: the checked-in block is what a release ships
entries.trigger: npm ci / npm install / npm pack (via `prepare`)
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten when an installed DSH home is found

entries.authority: the vitest alias table is derived from the vendor tsconfig
entries.trigger: node scripts/generate-maps.cjs (CI runs it, then git diff --exit-code)

entries.authority: the tsconfig path map is derived from the vendor tsconfig
compilerOptions.paths must match the vendored declarations
a run-scoped report under R33_RUN_ROOT is the run record
entries.trigger: node eval/r33/live.mjs --run without R33_LIVE (the gate refusal path)
entries.defaultBehavior: the refusal record replaces the latest live report
entries.safeOverride: R35_WRITE_LATEST=0 only covers writeRunReport, not the refusal path

entries.authority: the interface check is reproducible; the committed copy is a snapshot
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten with a fresh generatedAt on every check

entries.authority: the committed report is the offline arm-matrix record
entries.trigger: npx vitest run tests/r33-arms.spec.ts (also inside the full suite)
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten at the end of the arm matrix test

entries.authority: the committed report is the offline arm-matrix record
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten at the end of the arm matrix test

entries.authority: the committed report records the scripted self-test run
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten with a fresh generatedAt on every self-test

entries.authority: the committed comparison is the scorer record
entries.trigger: npm run eval:r33-compare (explicit generator, not a test)
entries.defaultBehavior: rewritten when the generator is run
